title: The window never shows a location, and two users may share a personal name
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell and select the Tag groups tab. An active location is selected (the location name shown next to the bell; change it with your initials at the top right -> Change Location).
  3. A second user at the same location: on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView").
custom_steps:
1. Open the New/Edit tag group dialog and look for any location field or chooser.
  2. Have two different users each create a personal group with the same name at the same location.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The dialog does not show or let the user choose a location.
  • Two users may each own a personal group with the same name at the same location.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-N7: “The dialog does not show or let the user choose a location.”
  • S6-E2: “Two users may each own a personal group with the same name at the same location.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
